text: Psalm 15 A Psalm of David. Lord, who will abide in Your tabernacle? Who will dwell in Your holy hill?
He who walks uprightly, and does righteousness, and speaks truth in his heart;
he who does not slander with the tongue and does no evil to his neighbor, nor bears a reproach against his friend;
in whose eyes a vile person is despised, but who honors those who fear the Lord; he who swears to avoid evil and does not change;
he who does not put his money out to usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be moved.
